method.description: Enumerated all open PRs via gh; compared each head to production/atlas-core using ancestry (merge-base --is-ancestor) and limited git cherry (baseline head base) for patch-equivalence of base..head commits. closeBlockers.impact: No PRs closed. Manual close of selected SUPERSEDED drafts recommended by a principal with write access.
